character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: long black hair tied with a pale-green cord, soft brown eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: a bamboo-craft apprentice who listens for the rhythm of the grove. Signature costume: a simple indigo work kimono, muted green haori, and woven sandals. Defining personal item: a hand-carved bamboo flute wrapped in cord. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in narrow path through towering bamboo, misty grove at dawn, stone lantern in a bamboo clearing; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with bamboo green, jade, mist white, light gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow upward tilt along tall stalks, gentle tracking down a narrow path, close-up of leaves in backlight; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
